title: Distill Until Divergence: Error-Truncated Hindsight Distillation for Agentic RL
title_zh: 蒸馏至分歧：用于智能体强化学习的误差截断后见之明蒸馏

paragraphs.en: Long-horizon interaction requires agents to make multiple decisions in a changing environment. Outcome-based GRPO lacks fine-grained guidance for intermediate decisions. Recent methods distill completed trajectories into reusable skills and use hindsight-conditioned OPD to provide dense token-level credit. However, skill-induced probability shifts do not necessarily represent reward-aligned credit; especially after an erroneous action changes subsequent interaction states, skill-conditioned supervision may become mismatched with the current state. To address this mismatch, we propose ETRO, which routes two complementary hindsight skills according to trajectory outcomes and error boundaries: Positive skills capture successful workflows to reinforce successful trajectories and pre-error decisions, while Negative skills capture failure-specific corrections to target decisive errors. The post-error suffix is optimized exclusively by GRPO, retaining outcome-based learning without extending potentially mismatched hindsight supervision. Extensive experiments demonstrate competitive task performance and support effective fine-grained credit allocation.
paragraphs.zh: 长时程交互要求智能体在不断变化的环境中做出多次决策。 基于结果的 GRPO 缺乏对中间决策的细粒度指导。 近期方法将已完成的轨迹蒸馏为可复用的技能，并使用后见条件化的 OPD 提供密集的词元级信用分配。 然而，技能引发的概率偏移并不一定代表与奖励对齐的信用；尤其是在错误动作改变后续交互状态之后，技能条件化的监督可能与当前状态不匹配。 为解决这一不匹配问题，我们提出 ETRO，它根据轨迹结果和错误边界路由两种互补的后见技能：正向技能捕捉成功的工作流程，以强化成功轨迹和错误前决策；负向技能捕捉针对失败的修正，以瞄准关键错误。 错误后的后缀部分仅由 GRPO 优化，从而在保留基于结果学习的同时，避免延伸可能不匹配的后见监督。 大量实验表明，该方法具有有竞争力的任务表现，并支持有效的细粒度信用分配。

paragraphs.en: Large language model agents are increasingly used for tasks that require sustained interaction with external tools and environments, including web navigation ( Wei et al., 2025 ) , household tasks ( Shridhar et al., 2020 ) , and search-augmented reasoning ( Huang et al., 2026 ) . These applications extend language models beyond single-response generation toward long-horizon task execution, where each action can alter the observations and choices available in subsequent turns.
paragraphs.zh: 大语言模型智能体越来越多地被用于需要与外部工具和环境持续交互的任务，包括网页导航（Wei et al., 2025）、家务任务（Shridhar et al., 2020）以及搜索增强推理（Huang et al., 2026）。 这些应用将语言模型从单轮响应生成扩展到长程任务执行，其中每个动作都可能改变后续轮次中可用的观察结果和选择。

sents.en: Large language model agents are increasingly used for tasks that require sustained interaction with external tools and environments, including web navigation ( Wei et al., 2025 ) , household tasks ( Shridhar et al., 2020 ) , and search-augmented reasoning ( Huang et al., 2026 ) .

paragraphs.en: Reinforcement learning provides a natural way to learn these strategies from interaction outcomes, but outcome-based GRPO lacks explicit guidance for intermediate decisions ( Shao et al., 2024 ) . Recent methods supplement it with trajectory-derived skills, using on-policy distillation (OPD) to provide token-level credit ( Yang et al., 2026b ; Wu et al., 2026 ) . Yet denser credit is not necessarily better-aligned credit: after an error changes the interaction state, the same skill may no longer guide subsequent decisions appropriately. Extending its supervision over the suffix can therefore introduce state-mismatched updates ( Tan et al., 2026 ; Qu et al., 2026 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 强化学习提供了一种从交互结果中学习这些策略的自然方式，但基于结果的GRPO对中间决策缺乏显式引导（Shao et al., 2024）。 近期方法利用轨迹衍生技能对其进行补充，采用在策略蒸馏（OPD）来提供token级别的信用分配（Yang et al., 2026b; Wu et al., 2026）。 然而更密集的信用分配未必是对齐更好的信用分配：当一次错误改变了交互状态之后，同一技能可能不再能恰当地引导后续决策。 因此，将其监督扩展到后缀部分可能引入与状态不匹配的更新（Tan et al., 2026; Qu et al., 2026）。

paragraphs.en: Our view is that hindsight should inform selective credit allocation. We refer to guidance extending beyond the states and decisions it meaningfully describes as hindsight applicability mismatch . A skill that explains a completed trajectory need not be equally applicable to every decision along it. An unrecovered decisive error can separate workflow consolidation, local correction, and outcome-based learning.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的观点是，后见之明应当为选择性的信用分配提供依据。 我们将超出其能够有效描述的状态与决策范围的指导称为「后见之明适用性错配」。 一项解释了已完成轨迹的技能，未必对轨迹上的每一个决策都同样适用。 一个未被复原的关键性错误，可能会将工作流巩固、局部纠正和基于结果的学习分离开来。

paragraphs.en: We propose ETRO to route two functionally distinct hindsight skills. A Positive skill summarizes a successful workflow and guides OPD throughout successful trajectories and over the pre-error prefix of failed trajectories. A Negative skill summarizes failure-specific corrections and guides OPD only at the writer-estimated first unrecovered decisive error. The post-error suffix remains optimized exclusively by GRPO, removing potentially mismatched auxiliary credit without discarding outcome-based learning. By integrating skill-conditioned OPD into the GRPO objective, ETRO combines targeted hindsight guidance with outcome-based learning without requiring skills during task execution.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出 ETRO 来路由两种功能不同的后见之明技能。 正向技能总结成功的工作流，并在成功轨迹以及失败轨迹的出错前缀上引导 OPD。 负向技能总结针对失败的具体修正，仅在被写入方估计的首个未恢复的决定性错误处引导 OPD。 出错后的后缀仍然完全由 GRPO 优化，在不丢弃基于结果的学习的同时移除可能不匹配的辅助信用。 通过将技能条件化的 OPD 融入 GRPO 目标，ETRO 将有针对性的后见之明引导与基于结果的学习相结合，且在任务执行期间无需使用技能。

sents.en: We propose ETRO to route two functionally distinct hindsight skills.
sents.zh: 我们提出 ETRO 来路由两种功能不同的后见之明技能。

sents.zh: 出错后的后缀仍然完全由 GRPO 优化，在不丢弃基于结果的学习的同时移除可能不匹配的辅助信用。

sents.en: By integrating skill-conditioned OPD into the GRPO objective, ETRO combines targeted hindsight guidance with outcome-based learning without requiring skills during task execution.

paragraphs.en: We evaluate ETRO on WebShop, ALFWorld, and Search QA using Qwen2.5 actors from 1.5B to 7B parameters. At 7B, ETRO achieves 85.8% WebShop success, 97.0% ALFWorld success, and 51.8% Search QA macro-average accuracy. Ablation studies further support the effectiveness of its selective credit allocation.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在 WebShop、ALFWorld 和 Search QA 上使用参数量从 1.5B 到 7B 的 Qwen2.5 智能体对 ETRO 进行评估。 在 7B 规模下，ETRO 在 WebShop 上达到 85.8% 的成功率，在 ALFWorld 上达到 97.0% 的成功率，在 Search QA 上达到 51.8% 的宏平均准确率。 消融研究进一步证明了其选择性信用分配的有效性。

paragraphs.en: We formulate hindsight applicability mismatch : skill-induced probability shifts need not provide reward-aligned credit after an error changes the interaction state.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了后见之明适用性失配（hindsight applicability mismatch）问题：技能引起的概率转移在错误改变交互状态后，未必能提供与奖励一致的信用分配。

paragraphs.en: We introduce ETRO, which separates workflow guidance from failure-specific correction and routes their OPD credit by trajectory region, while retaining outcome-based GRPO over the complete rollout.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出 ETRO，它将工作流引导与针对特定失败的纠正分离开来，并按轨迹区域路由它们的 OPD 优势分配（credit），同时在完整 rollout 上保留基于结果的 GRPO。

paragraphs.en: Extensive experiments across three agentic domains demonstrate ETRO’s effectiveness, with ablation studies validating its selective credit allocation.
paragraphs.zh: 在三个智能体领域开展的大量实验证明了 ETRO 的有效性，消融研究验证了其选择性信用分配机制。

paragraphs.en: Outcome-reward reinforcement learning optimizes policies from completed-trajectory feedback without requiring intermediate annotations, making it suitable for tasks with automatically verifiable outcomes. PPO stabilizes policy-gradient updates through clipping and a learned value function that estimates expected returns ( Schulman et al., 2017 ) . ReMax uses a rollout-derived baseline to reduce the need for a separately trained critic ( Li et al., 2023 ) . RLOO estimates advantages by comparing each sampled response with a leave-one-out baseline from other responses ( Ahmadian et al., 2024 ) . GRPO derives group-relative advantages from verifiable rewards within a sampling group rather than a learned value model ( Shao et al., 2024 ) . DAPO improves the stability and efficiency of group-based policy optimization ( Yu et al., 2026 ) . Search-R1 extends outcome-driven training to agents that interleave reasoning and search, using answer-correctness rewards ( Jin et al., 2025 ) . WebAgent-R1 trains interactive web agents using task-success feedback across multi-step interactions ( Wei et al., 2025 ) . Rather than changing the outcome-reward estimator, ETRO retains GRPO and supplements trajectory-level feedback with auxiliary hindsight credit routed according to the position and role of intermediate decisions.
paragraphs.zh: 结果奖励强化学习基于已完成的轨迹反馈来优化策略，无需中间标注，因此适用于结果可自动验证的任务。 PPO 通过裁剪和一个用于估计期望回报的可学习价值函数来稳定策略梯度更新（Schulman et al., 2017）。 ReMax 使用由 rollout 得到的基线，从而减少对单独训练评论家的需求（Li et al., 2023）。 RLOO 通过将每个采样的响应与其他响应构成的留一基线进行比较来估计优势（Ahmadian et al., 2024）。 GRPO 从采样组内可验证奖励中推导组相对优势，而不依赖可学习的价值模型（Shao et al., 2024）。 DAPO 提升了基于组的策略优化的稳定性与效率（Yu et al., 2026）。 Search-R1 将结果驱动的训练扩展到交替进行推理与搜索的智能体，并使用答案正确性奖励（Jin et al., 2025）。 WebAgent-R1 利用多步交互中的任务成功反馈来训练交互式网页智能体（Wei et al., 2025）。 ETRO 不改变结果奖励估计器，而是保留 GRPO，并根据中间决策的位置和角色引入按此路由的辅助事后信用，以补充轨迹级反馈。

paragraphs.en: On-policy hindsight converts post-rollout information into dense supervision on current-policy samples, using completed experience to guide subsequent policy updates. OPSD constructs self-teachers for distillation on the policy’s own sampled responses ( Zhao et al., 2026a ) . SDPO conditions self-teachers on feedback to improve supervision of those responses ( Hübotter et al., 2026 ) . RLSD constrains hindsight likelihood shifts when modulating reward-driven updates ( Yang et al., 2026a ) . Skill-SD summarizes interaction experience as natural-language skills for actor distillation ( Wang et al., 2026 ) . OPID uses trajectory-derived skills as privileged context for on-policy distillation ( Yang et al., 2026b ) . SEED distills skills extracted from completed experience into the agent ( Wu et al., 2026 ) . TRIAL calibrates hindsight signals through trajectory-relative normalization ( Zheng et al., 2026 ) . ATOD regulates distillation using uncertainty ( Tan et al., 2026 ) . ICSD calibrates supervision by its influence on the optimization objective ( Lan et al., 2026 ) . TurnSight assesses turn-level supervision through lookahead agreement ( Qu et al., 2026 ) . ETRO instead distinguishes the temporal applicability of workflow and failure-diagnostic skills, routing them before and at a diagnosed error while disabling auxiliary OPD on the subsequent suffix. ETRO thus addresses skill applicability, not only supervision strength. Truncating auxiliary OPD leaves outcome-based learning active on the suffix.
paragraphs.zh: 在策略的（on-policy）事后归纳将 rollout 后的信息转化为对当前策略样本的密集监督，利用已完成的经验来指导后续的策略更新。 OPSD 在策略自身采样的响应上构建自教师（self-teacher）以进行蒸馏（Zhao et al., 2026a）。 SDPO 让自教师以反馈为条件，以改进对这些响应的监督（Hübotter et al., 2026）。 RLSD 在调节奖励驱动的更新时约束事后归纳似然的变化（Yang et al., 2026a）。 Skill-SD 将交互经验总结为自然语言技能，用于 actor 蒸馏（Wang et al., 2026）。 OPID 将从轨迹中提取的技能用作特权上下文，以进行在策略蒸馏（Yang et al., 2026b）。 SEED 将从已完成经验中提取的技能蒸馏到智能体中（Wu et al., 2026）。 TRIAL 通过轨迹相对归一化来校准事后归纳信号（Zheng et al., 2026）。 ATOD 利用不确定性来调节蒸馏（Tan et al., 2026）。 ICSD 根据监督对优化目标的影响来校准监督（Lan et al., 2026）。 TurnSight 通过前瞻一致性来评估轮次级监督（Qu et al., 2026）。 ETRO 则区分工作流技能与失败诊断技能在时间上的适用性，将它们分别路由到诊断出错误之前和之时，同时在后续后缀上禁用辅助的 OPD。 因此，ETRO 解决的是技能的适用性问题，而不仅仅是监督强度问题。 截断辅助 OPD 后，基于结果的学习在后缀上仍然保持激活状态。

sents.en: On-policy hindsight converts post-rollout information into dense supervision on current-policy samples, using completed experience to guide subsequent policy updates.
sents.zh: 在策略的（on-policy）事后归纳将 rollout 后的信息转化为对当前策略样本的密集监督，利用已完成的经验来指导后续的策略更新。

sents.en: OPSD constructs self-teachers for distillation on the policy’s own sampled responses ( Zhao et al., 2026a ) .
sents.zh: OPSD 在策略自身采样的响应上构建自教师（self-teacher）以进行蒸馏（Zhao et al., 2026a）。

sents.en: SDPO conditions self-teachers on feedback to improve supervision of those responses ( Hübotter et al., 2026 ) .
sents.zh: SDPO 让自教师以反馈为条件，以改进对这些响应的监督（Hübotter et al., 2026）。

sents.en: RLSD constrains hindsight likelihood shifts when modulating reward-driven updates ( Yang et al., 2026a ) .
sents.zh: RLSD 在调节奖励驱动的更新时约束事后归纳似然的变化（Yang et al., 2026a）。

sents.en: Skill-SD summarizes interaction experience as natural-language skills for actor distillation ( Wang et al., 2026 ) .
sents.zh: Skill-SD 将交互经验总结为自然语言技能，用于 actor 蒸馏（Wang et al., 2026）。

sents.en: OPID uses trajectory-derived skills as privileged context for on-policy distillation ( Yang et al., 2026b ) .
sents.zh: OPID 将从轨迹中提取的技能用作特权上下文，以进行在策略蒸馏（Yang et al., 2026b）。

sents.en: SEED distills skills extracted from completed experience into the agent ( Wu et al., 2026 ) .
sents.zh: SEED 将从已完成经验中提取的技能蒸馏到智能体中（Wu et al., 2026）。

sents.en: TRIAL calibrates hindsight signals through trajectory-relative normalization ( Zheng et al., 2026 ) .
sents.zh: TRIAL 通过轨迹相对归一化来校准事后归纳信号（Zheng et al., 2026）。

sents.en: ATOD regulates distillation using uncertainty ( Tan et al., 2026 ) .
sents.zh: ATOD 利用不确定性来调节蒸馏（Tan et al., 2026）。

sents.en: ICSD calibrates supervision by its influence on the optimization objective ( Lan et al., 2026 ) .
sents.zh: ICSD 根据监督对优化目标的影响来校准监督（Lan et al., 2026）。

sents.en: TurnSight assesses turn-level supervision through lookahead agreement ( Qu et al., 2026 ) .
sents.zh: TurnSight 通过前瞻一致性来评估轮次级监督（Qu et al., 2026）。

sents.en: ETRO instead distinguishes the temporal applicability of workflow and failure-diagnostic skills, routing them before and at a diagnosed error while disabling auxiliary OPD on the subsequent suffix.
sents.zh: ETRO 则区分工作流技能与失败诊断技能在时间上的适用性，将它们分别路由到诊断出错误之前和之时，同时在后续后缀上禁用辅助的 OPD。

sents.en: ETRO thus addresses skill applicability, not only supervision strength.
sents.zh: 因此，ETRO 解决的是技能的适用性问题，而不仅仅是监督强度问题。

sents.en: Truncating auxiliary OPD leaves outcome-based learning active on the suffix.
sents.zh: 截断辅助 OPD 后，基于结果的学习在后缀上仍然保持激活状态。

paragraphs.en: Localized supervision provides finer-grained evidence about intermediate decisions than terminal rewards alone, distinguishing useful progress from errors within trajectories that share the same final outcome. Math-Shepherd estimates step correctness by sampling continuations from intermediate reasoning states and uses these estimates to train a process reward model ( Wang et al., 2024 ) . OmegaPRM applies divide-and-conquer search to locate the first erroneous reasoning step, turning outcome information into a localized process label ( Luo et al., 2024 ) . ROSD uses reflection to identify an erroneous span and directs self-distillation toward that span rather than uniformly supervising the entire response ( Zhao et al., 2026b ) . HSD conditions on a successful sibling trajectory to concentrate supervision near the point where successful and unsuccessful paths diverge ( Li et al., 2026 ) . Beyond localizing supervision, ETRO partitions failed trajectories at a diagnosed unrecovered error into Positive-guided prefixes, Negative-guided error turns, and GRPO-only suffixes.
paragraphs.zh: 局部化监督比仅依赖最终奖励能提供关于中间决策的更细粒度证据，能够在共享相同最终结果的轨迹内区分有用进展与错误。 Math-Shepherd 通过从中间推理状态采样后续内容来估计步骤正确性，并使用这些估计来训练过程奖励模型（Wang et al., 2024）。 OmegaPRM 应用分治搜索来定位第一个出错的推理步骤，将结果信息转化为局部化的过程标签（Luo et al., 2024）。 ROSD 利用反思来识别出错的片段，并将自蒸馏引导至该片段，而不是对整个回复进行均匀监督（Zhao et al., 2026b）。 HSD 以一条成功的姊妹轨迹为条件，将监督集中于成功与失败路径的分叉点附近（Li et al., 2026）。 除了局部化监督之外，ETRO 在诊断出的未恢复错误处将失败轨迹划分为正引导前缀、负引导错误轮次以及仅使用 GRPO 的后缀。

paragraphs.en: We investigate whether the alignment between skill-induced OPD signals and outcome-based action quality varies across trajectory regions. A GRPO-trained Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct actor samples eight complete trajectories per task prompt. The writer summarizes reusable workflows from successful and failed trajectories as Positive skills and failure-specific corrections as Negative skills. On failed trajectories, we quantify each skill’s influence by averaging the difference between skill-conditioned and unconditioned log-probabilities over each turn’s reasoning and action tokens. We assess alignment through Spearman correlations with step-level advantages derived from GiGPO’s state–action grouping approach ( Feng et al., 2026 ) , separately before, at, and after the diagnosed error. These advantages compare pooled action returns against a shared-state baseline; estimation and filtering details appear in Appendix C.1 .
paragraphs.zh: 我们研究由技能诱导的 OPD 信号与基于结果的动作质量之间的对齐是否在轨迹的不同区域之间存在差异。 由 GRPO 训练的 Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct 智能体对每个任务提示采样八条完整轨迹。 写入器从成功与失败的轨迹中总结可复用的工作流作为 Positive 技能，并总结针对失败的具体修正作为 Negative 技能。 在失败的轨迹上，我们通过在每个回合的推理与动作 token 上对有技能条件与无条件下的对数概率之差取平均，来量化每项技能的影响。 我们通过与由 GiGPO 的状态–动作分组方法（Feng et al., 2026）导出的步骤级优势之间的 Spearman 相关来评估对齐，分别在诊断出的错误之前、之时和之后进行。 这些优势将汇总的动作回报与共享状态基线进行比较；估计与过滤的细节见附录 C.1。

paragraphs.en: OPD modulation shows region-dependent correlations with the action-pooled reference advantage, with stronger positive associations in the prefix for Positive skills and at the diagnosed error for Negative skills than in the post-error suffix. As shown in Figure 1 , Positive modulation has a correlation of 0.59 0.59 in the prefix but 0.01 0.01 in the suffix; Negative modulation has a correlation of 0.46 0.46 at the diagnosed error but − 0.05 -0.05 in the suffix. The weak suffix correlations suggest that, after an error changes the interaction state, skill-induced probability shifts may no longer align with outcome-based action quality. This potential mismatch motivates testing Positive guidance before the error and Negative guidance at the error, while removing suffix OPD to avoid extending potentially mismatched skill supervision and retaining GRPO to learn from the trajectory’s actual outcome.
paragraphs.zh: OPD 调制与基于动作池化的参考优势呈现出区域相关的相关性，对于 Positive 技能，前缀中的正相关性强于错误后缀中的，对于 Negative 技能，诊断出的错误处的正相关性强于错误后缀中的。 如图 1 所示，Positive 调制在前缀中的相关性为 0.59 0.59，而在后缀中为 0.01 0.01；Negative 调制在诊断出的错误处的相关性为 0.46 0.46，而在后缀中为 − 0.05 -0.05。 后缀中的弱相关性表明，当错误改变了交互状态之后，技能引发的概率偏移可能不再与基于结果的动作质量保持一致。 这一潜在的不匹配促使我们在错误之前施加 Positive 引导、在错误处施加 Negative 引导，同时移除后缀的 OPD，以避免扩展可能不匹配的技能监督，并保留 GRPO 以从轨迹的实际结果中学习。

paragraphs.en: Figure 2 illustrates how ETRO routes hindsight supervision using a writer-estimated error boundary. For each completed trajectory τ i \tau_{i} , the writer produces a Positive skill z i + z_{i}^{+} that summarizes reusable task-solving strategies to reinforce effective decisions through OPD. For a failed trajectory, it also identifies the earliest turn k i k_{i} whose erroneous decision is judged decisive for the observed failure and remains uncorrected by later actions, and produces a Negative skill z i − z_{i}^{-} describing the decision, its consequence, and an executable alternative. This boundary separates Positive-guided decisions before the error from the local Negative correction at the error and the GRPO-only suffix. Failed trajectories without a valid boundary retain Positive guidance throughout; we represent this case by k i = ∞ k_{i}=\infty . Writer prompts, boundary validation, and skill construction details appear in Appendix A .
paragraphs.zh: 图2展示了ETRO如何使用由写入器估计的错误边界来路由事后监督。 对于每条已完成的轨迹 τ i \tau_{i} ，写入器生成一个正向技能 z i + z_{i}^{+} ，用以总结可复用的任务解决策略，从而通过OPD强化有效的决策。 对于失败的轨迹，写入器还会识别最早的轮次 k i k_{i} ，该轮次中的错误决策被判定为对所观察到的失败起决定性作用，且未被后续动作纠正，并生成一个负向技能 z i − z_{i}^{-} ，描述该决策、其后果以及一个可执行的替代方案。 该边界将错误之前的正向技能引导的决策、错误处的局部负向纠正以及仅使用GRPO的后缀区分开来。 没有有效边界的失败轨迹全程保留正向技能引导；我们用 k i = ∞ k_{i}=\infty 表示这种情况。 写入器提示词、边界验证以及技能构建的细节见附录A。

To assess skill selection and branch combination, we organize the Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct comparisons on WebShop and ALFWorld into five groups (Table 3 ): GRPO without OPD; Global Positive and Global Negative with one skill applied throughout the trajectory; Global Both with both skills combined globally; Positive Only and Negative Only with one branch removed from ETRO’s routing rule; and the complete ETRO method. Positive Only retains ETRO’s Positive guidance on successful trajectories, failed-trajectory prefixes, and complete failed trajectories without a valid boundary, while Negative Only retains its Negative guidance at diagnosed errors. All OPD variants use the same coefficient λ = 0.001 \lambda=0.001 and retain GRPO over the complete rollout; branch removal only changes the coverage of auxiliary supervision.

paragraphs.en: Suffix Supervision and Boundary Selection. To assess where supervision should end once both branches are available, we compare ETRO with Suffix Positive, Suffix Negative, and Random Boundary using Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct (Table 3 ). The two suffix variants keep ETRO’s Positive prefix and Negative error-turn guidance but continue the corresponding skill after the diagnosed error. Random Boundary keeps the same Positive–Negative–Off routing structure but partitions each eligible failed trajectory at a randomly selected turn instead of the diagnosed error. All variants retain GRPO over the complete rollout and the same OPD coefficient.
paragraphs.zh: 后缀监督与边界选择。 为了评估在两个分支都可用时监督应在哪里结束，我们使用 Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct 将 ETRO 与 Suffix Positive、Suffix Negative 和 Random Boundary 进行比较（表 3）。 两种后缀变体保留 ETRO 的 Positive 前缀和 Negative 错误轮次引导，但在诊断出的错误之后继续相应的技能。 Random Boundary 保持相同的 Positive–Negative–Off 路由结构，但不是在诊断出的错误处，而是在随机选择的轮次处划分每条符合条件的失败轨迹。 所有变体都在完整 rollout 上保留 GRPO，并使用相同的 OPD 系数。

To examine whether ETRO’s final gains are accompanied by sustained improvement during optimization, we compare GRPO, Global Positive, Global Negative, and ETRO using Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct on WebShop. paragraphs.en: Negative-skill placement. To examine whether failure-specific guidance benefits from placement at the decision it describes, we vary the location of the one-turn Negative OPD mask using Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct on WebShop. For failed trajectories with nonempty prefixes and suffixes, the writer produces a Negative skill for the validated error at turn k k . paragraphs.en: Writer reliability. To assess the quality of the skills and error boundaries that support routing, we evaluate 100 failed WebShop trajectories sampled after Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct training. Five annotators each inspect 20 distinct complete trajectories to establish reference annotations. Using these human annotations as reference answers, GPT-5.6 sol evaluates the writer outputs for boundary acceptance, exact-turn agreement, workflow validity, and correction validity. Results appear in Table 5 .

paragraphs.en: Post-error recovery. To assess whether suffix truncation improves behavior after a recoverable error, we compare actors from the same perturbed states on held-out WebShop tasks, collecting repeated continuations without hindsight skills. The actors retain Positive prefix and Negative error-turn guidance during training but differ in suffix treatment: Suffix Positive and Suffix Negative continue the corresponding OPD signal, while ETRO retains only GRPO. We report recovery success, normalized score, wrong-branch continuation, and first-turn action entropy; the controlled-error construction and evaluation procedure appear in Appendix C.2 .

paragraphs.en: ETRO achieves the highest recovery success and score and the lowest wrong-branch continuation rate among the compared actors (Table 6 ). paragraphs.en: We presented ETRO to address the mismatch between hindsight supervision and evolving interaction states. By separating workflow guidance from local error correction, ETRO routes OPD by skill polarity and trajectory position while preserving GRPO throughout the rollout. Experiments on WebShop, ALFWorld, and Search QA demonstrate competitive performance across model scales. Ablations support complementary skill routing and post-error truncation, while recovery experiments show improved recovery and less wrong-branch continuation. These findings suggest that effective hindsight credit allocation depends on both skill content and its temporal applicability. Future work could extend routing to multiple error and recovery boundaries.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出 ETRO 以解决事后监督与不断演化的交互状态之间的不匹配问题。 通过将工作流引导与局部错误纠正分离，ETRO 根据技能极性和轨迹位置对 OPD 进行路由，同时在 rollout 过程中全程保留 GRPO。 在 WebShop、ALFWorld 和 Search QA 上的实验表明，该方法是模型规模下的竞争性表现。 消融实验支持了技能路由与错误后截断的互补性，而恢复实验显示恢复能力有所提升，且错误分支上的继续执行更少。 这些发现表明，有效的事后信用分配既取决于技能内容，也取决于其时间上的适用性。 未来的工作可以将路由扩展到多个错误与恢复边界。

paragraphs.en: The writer evaluates an error using the complete later trajectory, rather than selecting the first locally invalid action. An error is recovered when subsequent actions correct its consequences, as supported by later observations and task progress; such an error is excluded from boundary selection even if the episode ultimately fails for another reason. Among multiple errors, the writer selects the earliest candidate that remains unrecovered and is judged decisive for the observed failure. A format violation alone is insufficient: it must pass the same recovery and decisiveness tests. If no such error can be identified confidently, the writer returns an empty step_skills object and the failed trajectory retains Positive OPD throughout alongside GRPO. This is a diagnosis of the realized episode, not a claim that the selected action makes failure inevitable.
paragraphs.zh: 写作者使用完整的后续轨迹来评估错误，而不是选择第一个局部无效的动作。 当后续动作纠正了错误的后果（由后续观察和任务进展所支持）时，该错误即被视为已被恢复；此类错误将被排除在边界选择之外，即使该回合最终因其他原因而失败。 在多个错误中，写作者选择最早的那个仍未被恢复且被判定对观察到的失败起决定性作用的候选错误。 仅格式违规本身并不足够：它必须通过同样的恢复性和决定性检验。 如果无法有把握地识别出这样的错误，写作者将返回空的 step_skills 对象，且该失败轨迹全程保留 Positive OPD 并与 GRPO 并行。 这是对已实现回合的诊断，而不是声称所选动作必然导致失败。

paragraphs.en: Analyze the following agent episode and return ONLY valid JSON. This experiment routes hindsight according to its temporal scope: - episode_skill is global positive guidance and must always describe what the policy should do to complete the task, regardless of whether the sampled episode succeeded or failed. - step_skills is local negative correction. It is used only for the first unrecovered decisive error in a failed episode and must include a concrete better decision, not merely a prohibition. {{ROUTING_INSTRUCTION}} How to interpret action validity: - ‘Action valid‘ is a deterministic FORMAT signal produced by the WebShop action parser, not a judgment made by this analyzer. - ‘Action valid: false‘ means the response violated the required response format: it was missing a complete <think>...</think> block, missing a complete <action>...</action> block, or contained Chinese characters. Treat this as direct evidence of a format error at that step. - ‘Action valid: true‘ means only that those format checks passed. It does NOT prove that the extracted action was admissible, executable, relevant, or semantically correct. Determine those properties from the current observation, admissible actions, and the following environment observation. - A format error is not automatically the decisive cause of episode failure. Apply the same recovery and decisiveness tests above using the complete later trajectory. Important constraints: - Step indexing is 0-based. - Select only from the supplied candidate step indices. - The candidate step indices include every interaction step in the complete trajectory; no steps are filtered out. - Ground every statement in the task, observations, admissible actions, and complete trajectory. - Keep episode_skill concise, actionable, and useful at every decision point. - Express reusable decision rules rather than leaking literal product IDs or other future-only details that were not available at the decision point. - Use at most one step_skills entry. A failed episode may use an empty object when no unrecovered decisive error can be identified confidently. - Return only: episode_summary, episode_skill, step_skills.

paragraphs.en: ALFWorld ( Shridhar et al., 2020 ) evaluates multi-step household tasks through textual observations and actions. We use 2,400 training examples from its training split and evaluate success on all 134 Unseen tasks. WebShop ( Yao et al., 2022 ) requires agents to search, filter, configure, and purchase products under compositional constraints. We use 2,400 training examples and all 500 evaluation tasks, reporting normalized task score and exact success rate.
paragraphs.zh: ALFWorld（Shridhar 等，2020）通过文本观察和动作评估多步骤的家庭任务。 我们使用其训练集中的 2,400 个训练样本，并在全部 134 个 Unseen 任务上评估成功率。 WebShop（Yao 等，2022）要求智能体在组合约束下搜索、筛选、配置和购买商品。 我们使用 2,400 个训练样本和全部 500 个评估任务，报告归一化任务得分和精确成功率。

paragraphs.en: We train Qwen2.5-Instruct actors at 1.5B, 3B, and 7B scales, using a frozen Qwen3.5-27B writer for all scales. After each completed episode, the writer generates hindsight skills, and the frozen behavior policy re-scores the original responses under the applicable skill contexts using teacher forcing. These operations add training-time computation; skills and writer calls are absent during evaluation.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在 1.5B、3B 和 7B 规模上训练 Qwen2.5-Instruct 智能体，并在所有规模上使用冻结的 Qwen3.5-27B writer。 在每个完整的回合结束后，writer 生成事后技能，冻结的行为策略在使用 teacher forcing 的条件下，于适用的技能情境下对原始响应进行重新评分。 这些操作增加了训练时的计算量；在评估阶段不存在技能和 writer 调用。

paragraphs.en: Each training batch contains 16 tasks for ALFWorld and WebShop or 128 tasks for Search QA, with eight rollouts per task. Thus, an ALFWorld or WebShop batch contains 128 training trajectories. Maximum actor prompt lengths are 2,048 tokens for ALFWorld and 4,096 for WebShop and Search QA, with at most 512 response tokens per turn. Both training and evaluation allow up to 15 interaction turns for ALFWorld and WebShop and four for Search QA. Overlong WebShop prompts are rejected, while Search QA uses left truncation.
paragraphs.zh: 每个训练批次包含 ALFWorld 和 WebShop 的 16 个任务或 Search QA 的 128 个任务，每个任务有八次 rollout。 因此，一个 ALFWorld 或 WebShop 批次包含 128 条训练轨迹。 actor 的最大提示长度在 ALFWorld 中为 2,048 个 token，在 WebShop 和 Search QA 中为 4,096 个 token，每轮回复最多 512 个 token。 训练和评估中，ALFWorld 和 WebShop 最多允许 15 个交互轮次，Search QA 最多允许 4 个。 过长的 WebShop 提示会被拒绝，而 Search QA 采用左侧截断。

paragraphs.en: ETRO adds the routed OPD token advantages to the GRPO advantages with a shared coefficient λ = 0.001 \lambda=0.001 for both skill polarities, rather than introducing a separate cross-entropy loss. We use token-mean aggregation over all valid actor response tokens, excluding environment observations and padding. Tokens without OPD supervision remain in the denominator and retain their GRPO advantages. The suffix-weight comparison uses this same denominator for every α \alpha , without separately normalizing by OPD-active or supervised suffix tokens.

paragraphs.en: To assess whether suffix truncation improves behavior after a recoverable error, we construct a controlled recovery suite from held-out WebShop tasks. We execute a pre-registered, plausible, recoverable wrong action from a shared reference trajectory, then start each actor from the same perturbed state and collect repeated continuations without hindsight skills. The compared actors retain Positive prefix and Negative error-turn guidance during training but differ in suffix treatment: Suffix Positive continues Positive OPD, Suffix Negative continues Negative OPD, and ETRO retains only GRPO. We measure recovery success, normalized score, the proportion of first continuation actions classified by a blinded evaluator as wrong-branch continuation, and entropy over those first-turn action tokens.
paragraphs.zh: 为评估后缀截断是否能在可恢复错误之后改善行为，我们从留出的 WebShop 任务中构建了一个受控恢复测试集。 我们从共享参考轨迹中执行一个预先注册的、看似合理且可恢复的错误动作，然后让每个智能体从相同的受扰动状态出发，收集多次重复的后续行为，且不使用事后技能。 被比较的智能体在训练期间都保留正向前缀和负向错误轮次引导，但在后缀处理上有所不同：Suffix Positive 继续正向 OPD，Suffix Negative 继续负向 OPD，而 ETRO 仅保留 GRPO。 我们测量恢复成功率、归一化分数、由盲评评估员判定为错误分支延续的首个后续动作所占的比例，以及首个动作词元上的熵。
